title: A Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
authors: Edward Farhi; Jeffrey Goldstone; Sam Gutmann
encoding_or_formulation: Cost Hamiltonian plus mixer Hamiltonian; p-layer alternating unitaries
key_takeaway: Defines QAOA and the p-depth approximation framework used by the later VRP papers.
limitations_or_questions: Not VRP-specific; use as method foundation and notation source.

title: Solving Vehicle Routing Problem Using Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
authors: Utkarsh Azad; Bikash K. Behera; Emad A. Ahmed; Prasanta K. Panigrahi; Ahmed Farouk
venue_or_source: arXiv:2002.01351; IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
encoding_or_formulation: Ising formulation for VRP using Qiskit
key_takeaway: Early concrete QAOA-to-VRP formulation; useful baseline for later critiques.
limitations_or_questions: Performance depends strongly on optimizer, p, initialization, and instance.

title: Quantum-Assisted Vehicle Routing: Realizing QAOA-based Approach on Gate-Based Quantum Computer
authors: Talha Azfar; Osama Muhammad Raisuddin; Ruimin Ke; Jose Holguin-Veras
encoding_or_formulation: Link-based VRP formulation; flow conservation and subtour elimination in cost Hamiltonian
scale_reported: Small VRP instances on gate-based hardware
key_takeaway: End-to-end gate-based implementation path; highlights penalty scaling, normalization, circuit depth, and noise.
limitations_or_questions: Scalability limited by circuit complexity and decoherence; cite as arXiv version unless a confirmed publication record is identified.

title: Applying quantum approximate optimization to the heterogeneous vehicle routing problem
authors: David Fitzek; Toheed Ghandriz; Leo Laine; Mats Granath; et al.; Anton Frisk Kockum
encoding_or_formulation: Ising Hamiltonian mapping for heterogeneous fleet capacities
scale_reported: Up to 21 qubits, corresponding to three customers and two trucks
key_takeaway: Extends QAOA routing work to heterogeneous fleets; reports quadratic qubit scaling in customer count and optimizer runtime trade-offs.
limitations_or_questions: Simulation scale remains small; optimizer trade-off needs careful extraction from results.

title: Qubit efficient quantum algorithms for the vehicle routing problem on NISQ processors
authors: Ioannis D. Leonidas; Alexander Dukakis; Benjamin Tan; Dimitris G. Angelakis
method: Variational quantum optimization with qubit-efficient encoding
encoding_or_formulation: Reduced binary-variable encoding; QUBO based on realistic shipping scenarios
scale_reported: 11 to 3964 routes in testbed; compared with Gurobi
key_takeaway: Important for resource reduction: approximate quality comparable to full encodings with fewer qubits.
limitations_or_questions: Even with encoding gains, larger instances still need more resources; inspect benchmark fairness versus Gurobi.

title: A Feasibility-Preserved Quantum Approximate Solver for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem
authors: Ningyi Xie; Xinwei Lee; Dongsheng Cai; Yoshiyuki Saito; Nobuyoshi Asai; Hoong Chuin Lau
method: Quantum Alternating Operator Ansatz / QAOA variant
encoding_or_formulation: New binary encoding; feasibility-preserving mixer; alternative shortest-path objective
key_takeaway: Core contribution is feasibility preservation, improving probability of sampling feasible and optimal solutions versus penalty QAOA.
limitations_or_questions: Need check how capacity constraint is bypassed/reintroduced and whether objective changes the original CVRP.

title: Quantum-Assisted Solution Paths for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem
authors: Lilly Palackal; Benedikt Poggel; Matthias Wulff; Hans Ehm; Jeanette Miriam Lorenz; Christian B. Mendl
encoding_or_formulation: CVRP reduced to clustering plus TSP subproblems; application-driven solution-quality metric
key_takeaway: Useful negative/critical evidence: QAOA often fails feasibility threshold, while VQE reaches it more reliably in their tests.
limitations_or_questions: Read carefully for hyperparameter settings and whether comparisons are problem-size limited.

title: Quantum Algorithm Exploration using Application-Oriented Performance Benchmarks
authors: Thomas Lubinski; Joshua J. Goings; Karl Mayer; Sonika Johri; Nithin Reddy; Aman Mehta; Niranjan Bhatia; Sonny Rappaport; Daniel Mills; Charles H. Baldwin; Luning Zhao; Aaron Barbosa; Smarak Maity; Pranav S. Mundada

key_takeaway: Foundation paper for QED-C application-oriented benchmarks; defines how to evaluate quantum applications beyond single hardware metrics.
limitations_or_questions: Not VRP-specific; use for benchmark methodology and reporting structure.

title: Optimization Applications as Quantum Performance Benchmarks
authors: Thomas Lubinski; Carleton Coffrin; Catherine McGeoch; Pratik Sathe; Joshua Apanavicius; David E. Bernal Neira

key_takeaway: Closest benchmark-method paper for QAOA/QA optimization: emphasizes performance progression over time and problem size.

title: Quantum Computing in Logistics and Supply Chain Management an Overview
encoding_or_formulation: Surveys quantum annealing, gate-based quantum computing, QAOA, routing, network design, fleet maintenance, cargo loading, prediction, scheduling
key_takeaway: Useful map of quantum computing applications in logistics; highlights hybrid methods and hardware limitations.
limitations_or_questions: Overview paper; verify original sources before citing specific empirical claims.

encoding_or_formulation: Encoding-agnostic go/no-go framework; QUBO versus HOBO/direct encoding resource counts

key_takeaway: Important reality-check paper: early quantum utility for CVRP is unlikely on NISQ hardware without decomposition or better encodings.
limitations_or_questions: The title in the user list omits one 'and Quantum Utility'; cite the arXiv title exactly.

title: Space-efficient binary optimization for variational quantum computing
authors: Adam Glos; Aleksandra Krawiec; Zoltan Zimboras
encoding_or_formulation: Reduces TSP qubits from standard N^2-style encodings toward log-factor-efficient permutation encodings, trading qubits for circuit depth
scale_reported: TSP-focused; encodings interpolate between qubit-efficient and depth-efficient models
key_takeaway: Key background for CVRP utility/resource papers: fewer logical qubits can mean higher-order terms and deeper circuits.
limitations_or_questions: TSP-focused, not CVRP-specific; apply to VRP/CVRP through encoding/resource trade-off rather than direct solver results.

title: Quantum Computing in the NISQ era and beyond
encoding_or_formulation: Noise-limited intermediate-scale quantum processors; limited reliable circuit size; path toward fault-tolerant quantum computing
key_takeaway: Foundational citation for why near-term quantum algorithms must account for noisy gates, limited depth, and lack of full fault tolerance.
limitations_or_questions: Perspective article rather than an algorithmic or empirical benchmark; use for framing NISQ constraints.

title: Variational quantum algorithms
authors: M. Cerezo; Andrew Arrasmith; Ryan Babbush; Simon C. Benjamin; Suguru Endo; Keisuke Fujii; Jarrod R. McClean; Kosuke Mitarai; Xiao Yuan; Lukasz Cincio; Patrick J. Coles

key_takeaway: Core citation for the hybrid quantum-classical structure of VQAs, including the rationale for using classical optimizers with shallow noisy quantum circuits.
limitations_or_questions: Broad review rather than VRP-specific; use to justify hybrid QAOA/VQA framing and known VQA challenges.

title: Assessing requirements to scale to practical quantum advantage
authors: Michael E. Beverland; Prakash Murali; Matthias Troyer; Krysta M. Svore; Torsten Hoefler; Vadym Kliuchnikov; Guang Hao Low; Mathias Soeken; Aarthi Sundaram; Alexander Vaschillo
